name: Day's Eye
source:
Daisy met Joshua at church and fell in love with him at first sight. "She" dreamt of becoming lovers with Joshua and that dream eventually came true. But there was just one secret Daisy had that she couldn't bring up with Joshua, no matter what...

However, those otherwise happy days would suddenly come to an end. Daisy despaired when her biggest fear became a reality. Joshua became uncertain when they hit a big wall in what was supposed to be a normal relationship.

Will the two be able to overcome numerous obstacles and regain their happiness?
[Translation of official website story summary.]
translation:
黛西在教堂遇见了约书亚，并对他一见钟情。“她”梦想着与约书亚成为恋人，而这个梦想最终实现了。但黛西有一个无论如何都无法向约书亚提起的秘密……

然而，这段原本幸福的日子突然走到了尽头。当自己最大的恐惧成为现实，黛西陷入了绝望。本应平凡的关系撞上一堵高墙，约书亚也开始感到不安。

两人能否克服重重阻碍，重新找回幸福？
[官方网站故事简介的翻译。]
